families.capacityAndCrowdingAssumptions: Early signals must precede crowded volume expansion and retain enough executable depth for the declared size.
families.continuationCriterion: Continue only while detection lead time and later-holdout precision remain stable across symbol and regime cohorts.
families.coverageAndMissingness: No versioned dormant-to-active discovery rules, point-in-time universe or event-grouped labels exist yet.
families.economicMechanism: Trade-intensity and liquidity state can transition before a fully developed price/volume event.
families.grossOpportunityDefinition: Probability or rank of an objectively defined post-cutoff ignition within horizon H, conditional on coverage.
families.hypothesis: Pre-cutoff intensity/liquidity changes improve early-transition ranking over simple activity baselines.
families.killRetirementCriterion: Reject if lead time disappears, calibration is unsupported, or the signal only detects already-active events.
families.minimumEffectiveEvidence: Event-grouped chronological cohorts with natural prevalence, purging/embargo and independent later regimes.
families.nullHypothesis: The features are contemporaneous activity measures with no usable lead over transparent baselines.
families.primaryMetric: Later-holdout precision-recall, calibration and median lead time at bounded focus capacity.
families.promotionCriterion: Meaningful later-holdout lead and calibrated uplift at the production focus budget.

families.capacityAndCrowdingAssumptions: Exit capacity is defined for explicit size and horizon; future candle highs are not executable exits.
families.continuationCriterion: Continue only while calibration, coverage and size-conditioned exit metrics hold on later event clusters.
families.coverageAndMissingness: Primary-source review is recorded, but Q has no objective event labels, contemporaneous depth outcomes or calibration cohorts.
families.economicMechanism: Post-onset flow, depth consumption and cross-market state may separate continuation from exhaustion/fade and constrained exit capacity.
families.grossOpportunityDefinition: Separate CONTINUATION_H, EXHAUSTION_H, FADE_H and EXIT_CAPACITY(q,H) targets after an explicit cutoff.
families.hypothesis: Leakage-safe market structure improves continuation/exhaustion and exit-capacity estimates over price-only baselines.
families.killRetirementCriterion: Reject probability semantics when calibration data are insufficient; retire features that fail tick/lot/filter controls or later cohorts.
families.minimumEffectiveEvidence: Whole-event chronological splits with natural prevalence, forward depth, explicit q/H labels and reliability uncertainty.
families.nullHypothesis: Scores reflect post-onset leakage, aggregation artifacts or non-executable hindsight and do not calibrate later.
families.primaryMetric: Brier/log loss and calibration slope/intercept plus fill fraction, impact and time-to-fill by q/H.
families.promotionCriterion: Calibrated later-holdout improvement and economically useful exit-capacity discrimination with adequate coverage.

families.capacityAndCrowdingAssumptions: Capacity is bounded by executable two-leg depth and shrinks under crowding; Q01 has no capacity observations.
families.continuationCriterion: Continue only while later chronological cohorts preserve calibrated net value after full economics and capacity stress.
families.coverageAndMissingness: Existing engines expose current proposals, but Q has no point-in-time lake, outcome cohort, fee/borrow history, or executable-depth atlas.
families.economicMechanism: Temporary Spot/perpetual dislocation may converge when carrying costs and executable two-leg capacity do not consume the spread.
families.grossOpportunityDefinition: Point-in-time executable two-leg basis convergence over a declared horizon and size, before costs.
families.hypothesis: A subset of normal Basis dislocations has positive net value after full two-leg economics.
families.killRetirementCriterion: Reject if later holdouts are non-positive after costs, calibration fails, or capacity is economically trivial.
families.minimumEffectiveEvidence: Multiple non-overlapping chronological regimes with acted, rejected, missed and quiet controls and complete two-leg economics.
families.nullHypothesis: After fees, funding, slippage, latency, recovery and selection effects, expected net value is non-positive.
families.primaryMetric: Later-holdout net expected value and calibration error by size/horizon, with coverage.
families.promotionCriterion: Positive lower uncertainty bound on net value across required regimes, stable calibration, and non-trivial executable capacity.

families.capacityAndCrowdingAssumptions: Borrow inventory and close-out capacity are hard constraints; both are unavailable historically in Q01.
families.continuationCriterion: Continue only while borrow truth is fresh and later cohorts retain net value under recall and recovery stress.
families.coverageAndMissingness: Historical borrow availability, liability state, recall risk and point-in-time rate truth are unavailable.
families.economicMechanism: Reverse dislocations can converge only when Spot borrow and liability economics make the short leg executable and recoverable.
families.grossOpportunityDefinition: Executable reverse-basis convergence for an explicit borrowed quantity, horizon and liability convention.
families.hypothesis: A subset of reverse Basis dislocations remains positive after borrow and recovery economics.
families.killRetirementCriterion: Retire if borrow truth cannot be obtained lawfully and point-in-time, or later net evidence is non-positive.
families.minimumEffectiveEvidence: Point-in-time borrow snapshots plus complete two-leg outcomes across independent regimes.
families.nullHypothesis: Borrow scarcity, interest, fees, funding and recovery costs remove the apparent reverse spread.
families.primaryMetric: Net expected value conditional on verified borrow capacity, with abstention coverage.
families.promotionCriterion: Fresh borrow truth, positive later-holdout lower bound, stable capacity and no authority bypass.

families.capacityAndCrowdingAssumptions: Capacity is defined for explicit size and horizon; public reaction is crowded, visible liquidity may vanish and future candle highs are not executable exits.
families.continuationCriterion: Continue only while event-clustered performance survives tick/lot/aggregation ablations, later regimes and explicit source-quality strata.
families.coverageAndMissingness: Q has primary-source constraints but no objective event/control labels, retained Event Atlas, complete sequenced depth outcomes or natural-prevalence calibration cohorts.
families.economicMechanism: False bursts and manipulation-like disorder can combine concentrated aggressive flow with fragile or vanishing executable liquidity; public patterns remain risk evidence, never intent truth.
families.grossOpportunityDefinition: Incremental reduction in future false-burst, exhaustion and constrained EXIT_CAPACITY(q,H) errors after an explicit pre-outcome cutoff, evidence-only.
families.hypothesis: Repeated wake/fade history, breadth, print concentration, flow-impact consistency and liquidity state reduce false-burst errors over transparent activity baselines without inferring intent.
families.killRetirementCriterion: Reject probability semantics when calibration is insufficient and retire features driven by post-onset leakage, future peaks, aggregation artifacts or unavailable L2 truth.
families.minimumEffectiveEvidence: Whole-event chronological natural-prevalence cohorts with purging/embargo, raw/degraded source flags and independent later regimes.
families.nullHypothesis: The challengers encode tick/lot, aggregation, missing-book, post-onset or cohort artifacts and do not reduce later false positives after multiplicity and cost controls.
families.primaryMetric: Event-grouped later-holdout false-positive reduction, Brier/log loss and calibration plus fill fraction, impact and time-to-fill by q/H.
families.promotionCriterion: Incremental later-holdout error reduction and economically useful size-conditioned capacity discrimination with calibrated uncertainty and no intent claim.

families.capacityAndCrowdingAssumptions: Public leadership can be arbitraged away; capacity and delay must be measured at the canonical producer's timestamps.
families.continuationCriterion: Continue only while later regimes preserve net value after source delay, cost and outage stress.
families.coverageAndMissingness: No externally licensed, canonically owned cross-venue source card or forward capture is accepted.
families.economicMechanism: Some venues or funding markets may lead Binance public state, but only if timestamps and transport delay leave usable net value.
families.grossOpportunityDefinition: Point-in-time predictive lead after measured arrival delay and Binance execution-cost simulation, evidence-only.
families.hypothesis: A licensed external venue/context stream adds later-holdout predictive value after realistic delay and costs.
families.killRetirementCriterion: Reject if identity/time semantics, retention rights or canonical ownership fail, or net lead vanishes after delay.
families.minimumEffectiveEvidence: Licensed forward capture across independent regimes with synchronized clocks and outage controls.
families.nullHypothesis: Apparent Granger/lead effects are common-factor, clock, selection or latency artifacts with no net value.
families.primaryMetric: Incremental later-holdout loss/decision value after measured source delay and full costs.
families.promotionCriterion: Licensed source, stable identity/timestamps, resilient capture and positive delayed net evidence.

families.capacityAndCrowdingAssumptions: Capacity depends on contemporaneous depth and on how many participants react to the same public funding rule.
families.continuationCriterion: Continue only if rule-versioned later regimes retain value after funding, spread and crowding stress.
families.coverageAndMissingness: Funding-rate history is partly available, but historical cap/floor rule revisions and complete frequency transitions are not yet manifested.
families.economicMechanism: Changes in funding interval, cap or frequency may alter positioning pressure and basis dynamics around settlement.
families.grossOpportunityDefinition: Rule-versioned change in future basis/stage distributions around verified funding regime transitions.
families.hypothesis: Verified funding-cap or frequency transitions condition later Basis and disorder outcomes.
families.killRetirementCriterion: Reject if transitions cannot be reconstructed point-in-time or later effects vanish after multiple-testing control.
families.minimumEffectiveEvidence: Several independently dated rule transitions with verified effective times and matched controls.
families.nullHypothesis: Observed behavior is ordinary market regime variation unrelated to the funding-rule transition.
families.primaryMetric: Matched later-holdout effect and calibrated outcome improvement by verified transition class.
families.promotionCriterion: Stable effect across independent transitions with complete rule provenance and net economic relevance.

families.capacityAndCrowdingAssumptions: Public announcements are rapidly crowded; any value must survive publication-to-receive delay and liquidity stress.
families.continuationCriterion: Continue only when a specific admitted source shows incremental later-holdout value across event classes.
families.coverageAndMissingness: No announcement, unlock or on-chain source has passed the launch Section 6 source-card admission gates.
families.economicMechanism: Listings, unlocks, announcements or on-chain state may condition market outcomes when identity and timing are point-in-time correct.
families.grossOpportunityDefinition: Incremental outcome information available strictly after a source's verified public timestamp and local receive time.
families.hypothesis: A narrowly admitted external context source improves a predeclared market-outcome target after delay and costs.
families.killRetirementCriterion: Reject sources without clear license/retention, stable identity or observable failure; retire non-incremental signals.
families.minimumEffectiveEvidence: Multiple independent event classes and later regimes with point-in-time identities and negative controls.
families.nullHypothesis: Context features are hindsight, identity, timestamp or selection artifacts and add no later-holdout value.
families.primaryMetric: Incremental later-holdout loss and calibrated decision value versus market-only baselines.
families.promotionCriterion: Source admission complete and later-holdout incremental value survives timing, cost and multiplicity controls.
